shots.idea: A crowd of small figures each types one line into a chat box, and one answer pops back to each.
shots.why: Shows the one-prompt habit the speaker is about to contrast.

shots.idea: A loop arrow circles a small robot that writes code, runs it and checks it, round and round.
shots.why: An agentic loop is easier to see than to hear.
